That gives `128x96x64`, which matches `16 * 4 * 2`, `16 * 1 * 6`, `16 * 4`. Tensile’s own code uses `MIWaveGroup` as wave decomposition and `MIWaveTile` as per-wave MFMA tiling in [KernelWriter.py](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/tensilelite/Tensile/KernelWriter.py#L1325), [KernelWriter.py](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/tensilelite/Tensile/KernelWriter.py#L4588). The notable optimizations are mostly scheduling, not a hidden data path. This kernel uses a single LDS buffer (`1LDSBuffer: 1`) with `PrefetchGlobalRead: 2`, `PrefetchLocalRead: 0`, `ScheduleIterAlg: 3`, `ScheduleGlobalRead: 1`, `ScheduleLocalWrite: 1`, so it is a real software-pipelined single-buffer kernel, not AB ping-pong [gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/library/src/amd_detail/rocblaslt/src/Tensile/Logic/asm_full/gfx1151/GridBased/gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml#L15911), [gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/library/src/amd_detail/rocblaslt/src/Tensile/Logic/asm_full/gfx1151/GridBased/gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml#L16076), [gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/library/src/amd_detail/rocblaslt/src/Tensile/Logic/asm_full/gfx1151/GridBased/gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml#L16077), [gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/library/src/amd_detail/rocblaslt/src/Tensile/Logic/asm_full/gfx1151/GridBased/gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml#L16084). It is not using `DirectToLds` or `DirectToVgpr` here [gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml](/home/user_aeefbb67/rocm-libraries/projects/hipblaslt/library/src/amd_detail/rocblaslt/src/Tensile/Logic/asm_full/gfx1151/GridBased/gfx1151_Cijk_Ailk_Bljk_HHS_BH_Bias_HAS_SAV_UserArgs.yaml#L15937). In one rocprof run it came out at about `256 VGPR`, `128 SGPR`, `30,336 B LDS`, `128 threads`; our current `(1,8,2,8,2)` kernel was about `192 VGPR`, `128 SGPR`, `24,576 B LDS`, `256 threads`. To close the gap, I would not chase direct-to-LDS or full AB double-buffer first. hipBLASLt’s fast kernel uses neither. The main thing to copy is its kernel family and schedule: add a dedicated long-K family close to `128x96x64` / `4,1,4,2,6`, then redesign our loop into a true single-buffer software pipeline. Right now our kernel still does “compute whole chunk, barrier, commit/pull next chunk, barrier” in [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L303), [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L307), [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L315), [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L321), [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L323), [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L328), while the current search space does not even contain a `4,1,4,2,6`-like family and tops out at `4,2,4,2,4` in [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L576), [hip_kernel_fp16.cu](/home/user_aeefbb67/ComfyUI-FeatherOps/kernel/hip/hip_kernel_fp16.cu#L606). So the shortest path is: - Add a narrow-N, 4-wave, `u=4` kernel family matching hipBLASLt’s shape. - Keep single-LDS buffering. - Overlap both A and B next-chunk global reads under current compute, not B-only and not only at chunk boundaries. - Accept a higher VGPR budget if it stays spill-free. - Preserve your zero-conflict B path, but retune the LDS layout/scheduling for the new `128x96x64` family. The key conclusion is that hipBLASLt is beating us with better deep-K software pipelining and a better long-K tile shape, not with a secret gfx1151-only memory path.
